entries.title: II Chronicles 24:2
segments: It is a great blessing for men, especially when young, to be surrounded with wise and pious counsellors; and in following their advice they will find the ways of wisdom to be ways of pleasantness and her paths to be paths of peace.

entries.title: II Chronicles 24:4
segments: Mnay are zealous in the externals of religion who have no real piety; and who, when left to the flattery of the wicked, will cast off the appearance of religion and be guilty of the most abominable iniquity.

entries.title: II Chronicles 24:7
segments: Wicked rulers, by their profane treatment of sacred things, corrupt the hearts of the people and bring down upon them the just judgments of God.

entries.title: II Chronicles 24:10
segments: When rulers, by their profane treatment of sacred things, corrupt the hearts of the people and bring down upon them the just judgments of God.

entries.title: II Chronicles 24:14
segments: Continually; the daily burnt-offering prescribed in the law of Moses is referred to.

entries.title: II Chronicles 24:17
segments:
Made obeisance to the king; rendered him homage, and made entreaty unto him for the restoration of idolatry in Judah. 
 
When pious persons who have been instrumental in keeping up public worship are removed by death, survivors who have no love for it often renounce it, and show by their conduct that their appearance of religion sprung from regard to men, not to God.

entries.title: II Chronicles 24:19
segments: Apostates who have cast off the fear of the Lord, are exceedingly averse to being reproved for their sins, and often hate, persecute, and even kill those who reprove them.

entries.title: II Chronicles 24:22
segments:
Require; that is, punish it. 
 
Though God sometimes suffers the wicked to kill his servants, and their punishment may be for a while delayed, it will, unless they repent, in due time overtake them.

entries.title: II Chronicles 24:24
segments:
Executed judgement; the just judgments of God against Joash for his sins. 
 
With a very small company God can easily overcome and desolate the country of those who rebel against him, and show them, by their punishment, his wrath against their iniquity.

entries.title: II Chronicles 24:27
segments: Burdens; either burdens in the sense of heavy judgments from God, or as the same word is rendered in
, burdens of tribute imposed on him by the conquerors.
